declare
 temp_buffer VARCHAR2(9);
 v_local_time date;
Begin
 -- Added by Kishore on 05/24/2011. IM 5356
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- End of change

 temp_buffer := :s_contract_id;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 select company 
 into :s_company 
 from contracts
 where contract_id = temp_buffer
 and contract_type='RG'
 --and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */--RP052918MLT#256
 and LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(temp_buffer, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y'
--RP052918MLT#253 
 and v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10); -- Changed "sysdate" to "v_local_time". Changed by Kishore on 05/24/2011. IM 5356
 NEXT_ITEM;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 select contract_id, company 
 into :s_contract_id, :s_company
 from contracts
 where upper(company) like ('%' || temp_buffer || '%')
 and v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10) -- Changed "sysdate" to "v_local_time". Changed by Kishore on 05/24/2011. IM 5356
 --and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */
 and LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y'
 and contract_type = 'RG';
 exception
 when too_many_rows then
 :s_contract_id := temp_buffer;
 :s_company := null;
 list_values;
 when no_data_found then
 -- show_error('5150');
 show_error('1147');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 when too_many_rows then
 :s_contract_id := temp_buffer;
 :s_company := null;
 list_values;
 when others then 
 handle_error; 
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_min_temp number(5,2);
 temp_count number;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 begin
 select b.min_temp, b.max_temp
 into temp_min_temp, :max_temp
 from batch_inputs b
 where b.batch_id = :batch_id and
 substr(b.batch_id,8,2) = 'RG' and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 exists (select 'x'
 from units
 where batch_id = b.batch_id
 and contract_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_contract_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */
 and (red_tube_2_flag is null or red_tube_flag is null 
 or purple_tube_flag is null or
 serum_plasma_ind is null));
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('1130');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*),
 count(decode(red_tube_flag, null,1,
 decode(red_tube_2_flag,null,1,
 decode(purple_tube_flag, null, 1,
 decode(serum_plasma_ind, null,1,null)))))
 into :s_unit_count, :s_count_no_trns
 from units
 where batch_id = :batch_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id ;
 if :s_unit_count = 0
 then
 show_error('0085');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
/*
 begin
 select count(*) into :s_count_no_trns
 from units
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and (red_tube_flag is null or
 purple_tube_flag is null or
 serum_plasma_ind is null)
 and contract_id=:s_contract_id
 and batch_id=:batch_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
*/
end;

 exception when no_data_found then

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_BATCH_ID_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select b.batch_id, /* Applied time zone changes by Kishore on 09/14/2015. IM 108 */ to_char(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:s_chapter_id, received_date), 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI') /* End of time zone changes for IM 108 */
from batch_inputs b 
where b.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id 
and batch_id in (select batch_id 
 from units 
 where contract_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_contract_id 
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id /* modified by hcl consulting */ 
 and (red_tube_flag is null or 
 purple_tube_flag is null or 
 serum_plasma_ind is null)) 
and substr(batch_id,8,2)='RG' 
order by insert_dats desc

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_S_CONTRACT__LOV0

select contract_id, company 
from contracts 
where ( contract_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_contract_id or 
 upper(company) like ('%'||:ctrl_blk_1.s_contract_id || '%')) 
and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id, sysdate) between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10) 
and contract_type = 'RG' 
and LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y'
order by contract_id

Trigger.Name: DO_COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 
 if form_success
 then
 :system.message_level := 0;
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');

end;
